name: ENRG Elements Limited
summary: ENRG Elements Limited is an exploration company working across Africa and seeking silver, copper and other base metals. It owns 100% of the Agadez project in Niger, covering 726 square kilometers with three granted permits and one pending application. It also has a stake in the Ghanzi West copper-silver project on Botswana's Kalahari Copper Belt, which has six prospecting licenses.
